verdicts.reason: A is a shrunk version of the portrait stack: the RSVP button has shrunk to badge size and is weaker than the pills above it, the 'Sunset Sessions' headline is about the same weight as the left-aligned 'Saturday 21 June', centred and left-aligned blocks are mixed, and the product sits stranded on the far right. B gives the headline a strong left column, but the right column is a cramped jumble. The tagline and venue wrap into narrow ragged lines, 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' floats away from the logo, the RSVP button is mixed into a 2x2 grid of badges so it reads as just another pill, the URL sits away from the button, and the legal text is unreadably small. A keeps a clearer reading order, so it is the less bad of the two.
